shared.full_text: Before creating or modifying Python, bat/cmd, shell/bash, PowerShell, Tcl, Node-only JavaScript, or static Dockerfile targets, think through the change and load both readable-python-generator and readable-script-generator; both gates must pass during the task before continuing.
shared.compact_text: Think before coding; all configured language gates must pass during the task before continuing.

python.full_text: For Python generation, modification, annotation, and normalization, readable-python-generator is the final owner; load it before editing and follow its task classification, comment, naming, and quality gates. readable-script-generator must not claim Python ownership.
python.full_text_without_script: For Python generation, modification, annotation, and normalization, readable-python-generator is the final owner; load it before editing and follow its task classification, comment, naming, and quality gates.
python.compact_text: Use the configured Python owner route before editing; Python remains outside this route when no owner is installed.

script.full_text: For bat/cmd, shell/bash, PowerShell, Tcl, Node-only JavaScript, and static Dockerfile targets, readable-script-generator is the final owner; load it before editing. Python remains on readable-python-generator, and a script wrapper that invokes an external Python command remains a script target; browser JavaScript or Docker daemon/build work is outside this route.
script.full_text_without_python: For bat/cmd, shell/bash, PowerShell, Tcl, Node-only JavaScript, and static Dockerfile targets, readable-script-generator is the final owner; load it before editing. Python is outside this route, and browser JavaScript or Docker daemon/build work is also outside this route.
script.compact_text: Use the configured script-family owner route before editing; Python remains outside this route when no owner is installed.
